 singapore FairPrice shoppers to get $5 for every $50 spent from Oct 29 to Nov 9
 Return vouchers can be used at all FairPrice outlets with no minimum spending required, starting from day after issuance till Nov 30 The latest round of FairPrice Return Vouchers runs from Oct 29 till Nov 9. PHOTO: FairPrice Group PUBLISHED ON October 29, 2026 12:59 AM BY Sean Ler Return vouchers are back at FairPrice from Oct 29 to Nov 9.
 Shoppers at FairPrice, FairPrice Xtra, FairPrice Finest and Unity pharmacies, will receive a $5 voucher for every $50 spent, up to a maximum of four return vouchers per transaction, FairPrice Group said on Thursday (Oct 29) morning. 
 These return vouchers can be used at all FairPrice supermarkets and Unity stores with no minimum spend, starting from the day of issuance till Nov 30, the group added.
 The sixth round of FairPrice Return Vouchers this year is part of the group's ongoing efforts to help households manage their grocery expenses, while providing additional savings as customers prepare for year-end festivities such as Deepavali (Nov 8) and Christmas.
 The last round of return vouchers was from Sept 17 to 27.
 That month, FairPrice Group enhanced its discounts for Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS) Blue and Orange cardholders, froze prices on 500 daily essentials and introduced a special $6 SG61 Return Voucher .
 It also lowered and locked prices of selected chicken and egg products across more than 100 of its outlets till Dec 31.
